messages:
jess_sales: Hey team — Lumos wants a hosted API key for their POC. Needs 7-day TTL, rotate at day 3, IP allowlist 203.0.114.0/24, and audit logs with prompt redaction. Demo in 36h. How quickly can we issue?

ravi_se: We can spin up an ephemeral key bound to their workspace. Recommend pre-demo renew at T-1h to avoid mid-demo expiry.

tara_security: Security: redact prompts/responses, retention 90d is OK for POC. Need approval ticket LUM-POC-321 before creation. Also request that revoke notifications go to #sales and to jess via webhook.

ben_ops: Ticket exists. Ops can create now. We'll name the key lumos-poc-sales-2409 and tag owner=jess_sales. Revoke playbook: 1) ops revoke -> immediate invalidation 2) webhook & channel notify 3) audit entry with reason.

ravi_se: Internal CLI we use (ops-only):

```
redwoodctl keys create \
  --name lumos-poc-sales-2409 \
  --workspace lumos-poc \
  --owner jess_sales \
  --ttl 7d \
  --rotate-after 3d \
  --pre-demo-renew 1h \
  --allowlist 203.0.114.0/24 \
  --redact-logs true \
  --audit-retention 90d \
  --notify-webhook https://hooks.redwood.sales/lumos/revoke
```

keybot: Created key: key_LUM456xyz (expires 2026-04-08T10:00:00Z). Rotation scheduled in 3 days. Pre-demo renew at 2026-04-05T09:00:00Z. Audit logging enabled (redaction: true).

jess_sales: Please DM the key to me securely. I'll not paste to customer chat. Also send the short revoke playbook I can forward.

tara_security: Revoke CLI example for ops: `redwoodctl keys revoke key_LUM456xyz --reason "sq_blocker"`. Ops confirm webhook hit and close ticket.

ben_ops: Done — key DM'd to jess. Automation added: if approval ticket state -> blocked, system auto-revokes and notifies #sales.

jess_sales: Great, sharing with Lumos. Will report back after their smoke test. :thumbsup:
